gameOver.reviveNoTargets: No blocks available to destroy. Returning to play now.

leaderboard.cached: Showing the most recently saved leaderboard.

errors.tooLong: Name must be 20 characters or less.

rankingRegister.title: Register Score
rankingRegister.description:
Enter your name to record your score.
Your name will be remembered next time.
rankingRegister.failureMessage: We couldn't submit your score. Check your connection or nickname and try again.
rankingRegister.rejectedMessage: This score did not pass verification yet. Play a bit longer and try again.
rankingRegister.rateLimitedMessage: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
rankingRegister.successMessage: Your score has been successfully added to the leaderboard.
rankingRegister.queuedMessage: You are offline. Your score will be submitted automatically when you reconnect.
rankingRegister.alreadySubmittedMessage: This run is already on the leaderboard. Each run can be submitted only once. Start the next run and beat your best!

activeGameExit.homeDescription: Scores are auto-saved to rankings while you play. You can move to menu now and still resume later.
activeGameExit.newGameDescription:
Starting a new run immediately overwrites the current normal-mode session, so it cannot be resumed.
Register now if you want to keep this run score.
activeGameExit.homeProceedHint: You can resume this run anytime
activeGameExit.midSaveButtonHint: Score is saved to rankings, and you can keep playing
activeGameExit.registerDescription:
You can record your current score even before game over.
After registration, you'll move to the next step.
activeGameExit.lockedNameNotice: This run is locked to the first registered name.
activeGameExit.midSaveSubmittedMessage: Your current score has been mid-saved.
activeGameExit.alreadySubmittedMidSaveMessage: This session is already registered. On older server versions, re-registering mid-save in the same session may be blocked, so the previous entry is kept.
activeGameExit.alreadySubmittedExitMessage: This session is already registered. Keeping the existing entry and moving to the next step.
activeGameExit.newGameOverwriteNoticeTitle: Important: Only one normal session is kept
activeGameExit.newGameOverwriteNoticeBody:
The moment a new run actually starts, resume data for the previous normal run is deleted.
Mid-save records score only; once you start a new run, the previous run cannot be restored.
activeGameExit.midSaveButtonHintNewGame: Record the score only and keep the current run. New run start is canceled.
activeGameExit.midSaveSubmittedMessageNewGame: Current score was recorded. Your existing run is still kept, and you can resume it from the menu.

cropper.description: Drag to move the image and use zoom to fit the area.
